g.text: Δ Notation & Badges: Pill badges show metric delta relative to GMR Baseline (Δ = Method - Baseline).

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: • Green badges [e.g. +6.67 or -5.65] indicate statistically favorable gains: mAP/Rej-F1/AUROC increased, or Orc-Gap decreased.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: • Red badges indicate regressions relative to baseline. Bold values mark the best performance across methods for each backbone.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Method 1 (GMR Baseline): Official temporal DETR baseline checkpoints with standard bipartite matching.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Method 2 (GMR + SI-Bind [E9 / CAB]): Stage-1 Triad (Controlled Refresh → Temporal Re-binding → Context Innovation). Resolves feature drift & multi-GT confusion.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Method 3 (GMR + SI-Bind [E9] + GEQ [Ours]): Stage-2 Global Event Query calibration on top of E9. Sequence energy anchoring eliminates false positive hallucinations.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Metric Definitions: mAP (%) over IoU thresholds [0.1:0.1:0.9]; Orc-Gap (%) = area between Oracle envelope and G-mIoU@1 threshold curve across τ ∈ [0, 1] (lower is better);

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Rej-F1@.5 (%) = F1 score for non-present target moment rejection at default 0.5 presence threshold; AUROC (%) = Area under ROC presence curve. FlashVTG pending.
